_readme: What the world outside football looked like in the week each NFL game was played.
TO ADD A SEASON: add a key for the year, then one entry per week the game can
deal (currently 7 through 17 — see FIRST_WEEK and LAST_WEEK in league.ts).
Every field is optional. A week with no entry, or an entry with no headline,
simply omits that line from the card.
SHAPE: { song, artist, headline }.
HOW TO WORK OUT WHICH WEEK: find the Sunday that NFL week was played. Week 1
Sunday was 9 Sep 2007 and 13 Sep 2015, and weeks run consecutively, so week N
is that date plus 7*(N-1). Week 17 spills into January — 2015's week 17 was
played on 3 Jan 2016.
SONGS: Billboard Hot 100, taking the issue dated the Saturday before the
Sunday. Source: Wikipedia, 'List of Billboard Hot 100 number ones of <year>'.
Complete for both seasons.
HEADLINES — WHAT TO PICK, in order of preference:
1. SPORT, and a sport other than American football. A World Series, a
rugby final, an NBA trade, a title fight. The player is already deep in
one sport; another one places the week without competing with it, and a
second NFL story would just be more of what's already on screen.
2. Something that lifts. 'Biggest story of the week' selects hard for
catastrophe — left alone this set became wildfires, a suspended
constitution, a cyclone and two assassinations. Where a real, checkable
alternative sits in the same seven days, take it.
3. The week's actual biggest story, when neither of the above exists.
Some weeks have no bright side and shouldn't be given a false one:
November 2015 really was Paris.
HEADLINES — HOW TO CHECK: every one is verified against its own Wikipedia
article. Never a month summary, which is where the errors live — an early
attempt at bulk extraction dated the Kenyan general election to November when
it was 27 December. Never recalled from memory either. Weeks with no entry
are blank on purpose: an invented front page printed as fact is worse than
none, and a wrong date is worse still because it reads as authoritative.
One event, one article, one date confirmed.
